decision: Retain new licensed TRAIN data and research checkpoints; do not promote either classifier to Pi

new_training_data.background_policy: Explicit visual labels plus no source-balloon overlap for unmatched proposals. Initial contaminated trial invalidated before evaluation.

training_fit: Both clean admit seeds correctly classify 9/12 new red crops, 14/18 blue crops and 31/36 backgrounds. Parent: 6/12 red, 10/18 blue, 30/36 background. These are TRAIN measurements, not qualification.
development_findings: 62-frame panel: parent blue51TP/25FP/16FN; admit47 blue52/23/15; admit48 blue52/22/15. Matched controls blue52/26/15 and51/25/16. Admit48 also loses one red TP.
67-frame panel: parent blue59/13/12; admit47 blue58/13/13; admit48 blue59/12/12. Red counts unchanged. No robust recall improvement across seeds.
12-frame panel: both admit seeds lose one red TP and remove one red FP; blue unchanged from parent.

localization_bottleneck.meaning: This upper bound assumes perfect classification and selection among existing proposal boxes; changing or refining boxes can change the bound. It is not a bound on all possible models.

next_action: Prioritize proposal geometry and localization. Use the newly reviewed source boxes as sparse TRAIN supervision for the tiny localizer, with unknown image regions masked rather than labeled background. Keep matched controls and frozen existing development evaluation; collect independent representative Pi scenes separately.
scope: Repeated development only; source expansion is not a new held-out benchmark. No threshold sweep, Pi runtime change, ESP32 access or motor command.
